_comment: One animal per team, one short trait each. Traits are recorded but not yet applied by the rules engine.

trait.label: Opportunist
trait.description: Takes an extra item from any hex it searches.

trait.label: Trailbreaker
trait.description: Ignores the first delay it suffers each stage.

trait.label: Scout
trait.description: Peeks at one adjacent hex before committing a move.

trait.label: Engineer
trait.description: Crosses creek hexes as if they were trail.

trait.label: Ambusher
trait.description: Wins ties in a head-to-head encounter.

trait.label: Unhurried
trait.description: Cannot be eliminated by its first hazard.

trait.label: Sentinel
trait.description: Learns the contents of a hex two steps away once per stage.

trait.label: Forager
trait.description: Converts any reward hex into a consumable.

trait.label: Trickster
trait.description: May swap one of its items with an encountered team.

trait.label: Night Eyes
trait.description: Treats one misleading clue per stage as if it were accurate.
